name: First run
question: One world of 32 cells, 128 steps. Can it be replayed exactly?
result: Yes. Events, measures and summary match byte for byte. One seed only, so it says nothing general.
design: One trajectory. N = 32, density 0.25, seed 183742, 128 synchronous steps.
numbers: Occupancy 0.34375 to 0.1875. Resource total 32 at both ends. Events, metrics and summary match byte for byte.

name: Law 25%
question: Does the law do anything compared with a frozen world? Sparse start.
result: Fewer groups in all 64 pairs. Mean change −4.27 (95% interval −4.67 to −3.86).
design: 64 matched pairs, seeds 183743 to 183806. N = 32, density 0.25, 128 steps, majority against a frozen control.
numbers: Mean paired change in groups −4.265625, 95% t interval [−4.671690, −3.859560]. Negative in 64 of 64.
limit: One law, one size, one density.

name: Law 50%
question: Same question, balanced start.
result: Fewer groups in all 64 pairs. Mean change −5.45 (95% interval −5.92 to −4.98).
design: 64 matched pairs, seeds 183807 to 183870. N = 32, density 0.5, 128 steps, majority against a frozen control.
numbers: Mean paired change in groups −5.453125, 95% t interval [−5.921882, −4.984368]. Negative in 64 of 64.
limit: One law, one size, one density.

name: All at once?
question: Does it matter if cells update together or one by one?
result: Yes. 49 of 64 matched starts end elsewhere (95% interval 65% to 85%).
design: The 64 starts of the previous test, synchronous against one random sequential order each.

name: Four orders
question: Same start, four random orders. One ending or several?
result: Several for 56 of 64 starts. 2.67 endings on average, a lower bound.
design: The same 64 starts, four independent random orders each, order seeds 910000 to 910255.
numbers: 56 of 64 starts reach several endings, 0.875, Wilson 95% [0.772254, 0.935278]. Mean 2.671875 endings.
limit: Four orders give a lower bound.

name: One poke
question: Flip one cell of a settled world. Does it come back?
result: 35 of 64 end elsewhere, 29 are restored exactly. The link with borders was noticed after the fact, so it was retested.
design: 64 settled worlds, one flip at tick 8, target = seed mod 32.
numbers: 35 of 64 endings change, 0.546875, Wilson 95% [0.425736, 0.662706]. 29 return exactly.
limit: The link with borders was seen afterwards, then retested.

name: Poke 32 cells
question: Registered in advance: does the distance to a border decide?
result: At distance 0 and 1, all 64 change. At distance 2 or more, none does.
design: 64 settled worlds at N = 32, three flips each, at border distance 0, 1 and 2 or more. Registered in advance.
numbers: 64/64, 64/64 and 0/64 endings change. Wilson 95% [0.9434, 1] near, [0, 0.0566] far.
limit: Lowest eligible cell only. One law, one density.

name: Poke 64 cells
question: Does it still hold in a world twice as large?
result: Same split on 64 new starts. One size transfer, nothing more.
design: 64 new worlds at N = 64, seeds 183871 to 183934, three flips each.
numbers: 64/64, 64/64 and 0/64 endings change. Matched near-minus-far contrast 1.000 in all 64.

name: Two-bit loop
question: In a tiny loop, does cutting an inner link stop what it maintains?
result: Yes, at step 9, and replacing the role keeps it. But we wrote the rule, so this is a check of the fixture.
design: Two-bit deterministic loop, eight conditions in two orientations, 64 transitions, cut between ticks 8 and 15.
numbers: Output lost at state 9 under the cut; kept under sham, inner substitution and outside replacement. 16 exact replays.
limit: The transition rule encodes the contrast. Not run on the Otto engine.

name: Renewal measure
question: Can a measure tell real self-renewal from look-alikes, whoever is looking?
result: All look-alikes were caught. But 38 of 128 paths changed verdict with the observer, so we rejected our own measure.
design: 327 paths: 128 candidate, 128 paired external mirrors, 64 noise, 7 deterministic. Eight admissible observers, locked before the run.
numbers: Positive reference passes 8 of 8 observers. 198 negative paths: no pass. 38 of 128 candidate paths change verdict across observers.
limit: Rejected as observer-sensitive. Says nothing on life, autonomy or organisation.

name: Cut & replace
question: Which inner part really keeps the whole going, once every outside help is matched?
result: Not run. It stays blocked until a measurement survives.
design: Planned: cut inner roles against matched outside, resource and boundary controls.
